description:
One build of one index from one lakehouse snapshot under one model.

This is the record Day 23 lacked: it says what the index was built from, so index lag
is a computed number and a response can name the exact index it read.

created_at.description: When this row was written (UTC, timezone-aware). Freshness is computed from it.
created_at.title: Created At

embedding_model_id.description: Embedding model as provider/name@version:dims. The model is the namespace of every vector it produced; two models never share an index.
embedding_model_id.title: Embedding Model Id

index_name.description: '{base}--{model slug}': the model is part of the name (versions are namespaces).
index_name.title: Index Name

lag_seconds_at_build.description: Newest source_updated_at in the lakehouse minus the snapshot time, at build.
lag_seconds_at_build.title: Lag Seconds At Build

lakehouse_snapshot_id.description: Iceberg snapshot id of the embeddings table the build read.
lakehouse_snapshot_id.title: Lakehouse Snapshot Id

row_count.description: Vectors in the index at build time.
row_count.title: Row Count

schema_version.description: Version of this row's schema. Bumped on any field change; see CONTRIBUTING.md.
schema_version.title: Schema Version

status.description: Only one snapshot per index_name is live; cutover moves a pointer.
status.title: Status

tenant_id.description: Tenant that owns the row. Every index query and cost report filters on it.
tenant_id.title: Tenant Id

title: IndexSnapshot
